name: Other armed conflicts
value: Ethiopia: Tigray fighting; Badme clash reported
summary: Ethiopian forces retook Rama in Tigray on 7 Nov; a clash with Eritrean forces near Badme was reported on 9 Nov
state: Ethiopian federal forces clashed with Tigrayan forces around Rama on 7 Nov and reportedly retook it, after capturing Sheraro on 3 Nov (Critical Threats, 10 Nov). Eritrea reportedly reinforced positions around Badme and a clash with Ethiopian forces there was reported on 9 Nov, though which side of the border is unconfirmed. Clashes between Ethiopia's Oromia and Somali regions have driven tens of thousands into Kenya's Moyale (UN News). No capital is under attack and no interstate war is confirmed.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia, including Tigray and border areas. Fighting disrupts aid and movement in northern Ethiopia; displaced families in Moyale rely on UN agencies and the Kenya Red Cross.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration (Ethiopia–Tigray war); interstate war with Eritrea unconfirmed (Alert line)
